title: Concentration on influential or large sets
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, let $\varepsilon>0$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. Suppose the total influence $I(f)$ is positive. Set $\tau=\dfrac{\varepsilon^2}{I(f)^2}\left(\dfrac{1}{9}\right)^k$, and let $J$ consist of the coordinates whose Boolean influence is at least $\tau$. Then the total squared Fourier coefficient mass outside the family consisting of all subsets of $J$ together with all subsets of $[n]$ of size greater than $k$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function on the sign cube
The total influence of f is positive
